“师傅，你还活着吗？”
雄浑低沉的声音，在白雪皑皑的峰顶回荡，听不出一丝感情。
剑横秋一身黑袍，雄壮高大身影仿佛一尊黑塔一般，屹立在一片白色雾气之外，棱角铮铮的面庞，紧紧绷着，目光雪亮锋利，仿佛一把随时会出鞘的刀。
这里是怒火道宗的冰云峰，宗主“狼虎道君”赢商的闭关之地。除了剑横秋等几个亲近的嫡系弟子，和有限几个老家伙，其他人一概不准接近。
此时此刻，剑横秋身后，还有六个青年男女，个个仿佛狼崽子，目光凶悍，杀气腾腾。沉重的呼吸，随雪花一起飞荡！
七人今天，要干一件大事！
……
“有你们这帮逆徒在，老夫离死也不远了！”
好一会之后，翻腾的雾气里，终于有声音传来，低沉沙哑。
剑横秋笑了。
他七岁就被赢商带进怒火道宗，得到赢商亲传，算有几分师徒情义，可惜赢商之前出山争夺机缘，遭了算计，服下毒丹，不光生机飞快流逝，而且元气也在流逝，境界还在层层跌落。
剑横秋身为修士，毕竟见惯生死，悲愤过后，心中隐隐高兴起来。
赢商若死，下一任宗主，多半是他，老家伙的身家，自然也是他的，于是兴奋等待起来。
但一天天下来！
一连三年！
赢商竟然始终没死，縮在老巢的雾气阵法里，不知道如何一直苟延残喘着，剑横秋终于再等不及！
“师傅既已看穿生死，徒弟们——就送师傅最后一程，祝师傅求仁得仁，早登极乐，动手！”
厉喝声音，滚如炸雷。
唰！

话音落下，剑横秋手在腰间一个灰布口袋上一拂，手上已经多了一把金光闪闪的阔剑，散发着浩瀚如潮水的气息，正是赢商亲手赐给他的金潮剑。
金剑一扬，金光闪闪的浪潮，顿时涌动起来，扫荡向了前方的雾气！
其他六人见状，也是二话不说，有的取出自己的法宝，有的掐起手诀，一起朝雾气大阵，展开了攻击。
轰轰轰——
一瞬之间，轰隆之声大作！
天摇地晃，冰云峰剧烈颤抖起来。
……
“你们这帮狗东西，好大的胆子，竟敢弑师！”
雾气深处里，赢商怒喝。
愤怒的情绪，仿佛狂躁的风一样，卷动着漫天的雪花，激射如电。
“哈哈哈——”
剑横秋大笑，双目放光，一头乌黑长发，狂龙一般飞舞起来。
“师傅，你老人家，反正也没几天活头了，不如早点死，早点将宗主的位置，交到弟子手上，让我来带领怒火道宗大兴！”
“瞧瞧吧，这些年来，在你的统帅下，我们怒火道宗，除了我们几个你亲手收进宗的弟子，还有几个来投的，连师伯师叔他们都跑光了！”
“师傅，你的时代结束了，现在是我的时代！”
“欲成大事，必先弑师，徒儿今天，就是要弑师，成就我的通天大道！”
剑横秋眉目飞扬！
越说越是兴奋！
瞳孔大睁，一身热血都开始沸腾起来！

"Master, are you still alive?"
The powerful and deep voice echoed on the snow-capped peaks, and there was no trace of emotion.
Jian Hengqiu was dressed in black robes. His majestic and tall figure was like a black tower, standing outside the white mist. His angular face was tightly tensed, and his eyes were sharp and sharp, as if he was a knife that would be unsheathed at any time.
This is the Bingyun Peak of the Wrath Taoist Sect, the retreat place where the sect leader "Langhu Taoist" Yingshang retreats. Except for Jian Hengqiu and a few close direct disciples, and a limited number of old guys, no one else is allowed to approach.
At this moment, behind Jian Hengqiu, there were six young men and women, all of them looked like wolf cubs, with fierce eyes and murderous intent. Heavy breathing, flying with the snowflakes!
Seven people are going to do something big today!
…
"With traitors like you here, I'm not far away from death!"
After a while, in the churning fog, a voice finally came, low and hoarse.
Jian Hengqiu smiled.
He was brought into the Wrath Dao Sect by Ying Shang when he was seven years old, and was personally taught by Ying Shang, which was considered to be a kind of master-disciple relationship. Unfortunately, Ying Shang came out to fight for opportunities before, and was tricked and took poison pills. Not only did his vitality disappear quickly, but his vitality was also passing away, and his realm was still falling layer by layer.
As a monk, Jian Hengqiu was used to seeing life and death. After his grief and anger passed, he felt faintly happy.
If Ying Shang dies, he will most likely be the next sect leader. The old guy's net worth will naturally be his, so he waits excitedly.
But day by day!
Three years in a row!
Ying Shang actually survived. He was huddled in the mist formation in his lair. He didn't know how to survive, but Jian Hengqiu finally couldn't wait any longer!
"Since the master has seen through life and death, the disciples - I will send the master off for the last journey. I wish the master will be kind and achieve happiness soon. Let's do it!"
The fierce shouting sound was like thunder.
Uh-huh!
After he finished speaking, Jian Hengqiu flicked his hand on a gray cloth pocket on his waist. There was already a shining golden broad sword in his hand, exuding a vast aura like the tide. It was the Golden Tide Sword given to him by Ying Shang himself.
As soon as the golden sword was raised, a wave of glittering golden light suddenly surged up, sweeping towards the mist ahead!
When the other six people saw this, they didn't say anything. Some took out their own magic weapons, some made up their hand seals, and together they launched an attack on the mist formation.
Boom boom boom——
In an instant, there was a loud rumbling sound!
The sky shook and the earth shook, and Bingyun Peak began to tremble violently.
…
"You guys are so brave, you dare to kill your master!"
Deep in the mist, Ying Shang shouted angrily.
The angry emotion was like a raging wind, swirling the snowflakes all over the sky, surging like lightning.
"Hahaha——"
Jian Hengqiu laughed, his eyes shining, and his long black hair flying like a wild dragon.
"Master, you old man only has a few days left to live anyway. Why don't you die as soon as possible and hand over the position of sect leader to your disciples as soon as possible and let me lead the Wrath Dao Sect to great prosperity!"
"Look, over the years, under your command, our Angry Dao Sect, in addition to a few of our disciples that you personally accepted into the sect, there are also a few who came to join us. Even our uncles and uncles have all escaped!"
"Master, your time is over, now is my time!"
"If you want to achieve great things, you must first kill your master. Today, my disciple, I will kill my master to achieve my great goal!"
Jian Hengqiu’s eyebrows are flying!
The more I talk about it, the more excited I get!
His pupils opened wide and his blood began to boil!
